title: Stare At The Cross For 10 Seconds 😳 #shorts
description:
Don't move your eyes... a green dot appears out of nowhere, then a black-and-white photo turns full colour. Two classic perception illusions (the lilac chaser and the negative afterimage).

Subscribe for a new brain glitch every day.

#opticalillusion #illusion #staretest #brain #psychology #shorts

segments.text: Stare at the black cross. Do not move your eyes.
Keep staring. In a few seconds, a green dot starts spinning around.
Now the pink dots are disappearing.
There is no green dot. Your eyes are inventing it.
Next. Stare at the red dot on this weird picture. Don't blink.
Now. It's in full colour, right? This picture is black and white.
Subscribe for a new brain glitch every day.
